title: France’s Election And The Law Of Surprise
gist: Gavekal flags France's April 18 / May 2, 2027 presidential election as one of the biggest political events for European assets, with polls pointing to a Le Pen–Mélenchon run-off that Le Pen leads ~68% to 32%; the title's 'law of surprise' framing hints that a five-month-out consensus may not hold (teaser only).

insights.claim: France's 2027 presidential election, with rounds on April 18 and May 2, is one of the biggest political events for European assets in 2027, according to Gavekal.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Put the April–May 2027 window on the European risk calendar (OATs spreads, French banks, EUR).
insights.quote: One of the biggest political events for European assets in 2027
insights.locator: One of the biggest political events

insights.claim: Five months before France's 2027 presidential election, polls show Marine Le Pen at about 33% of first-round voting intentions and Jean-Luc Mélenchon a distant second at 18%, both well ahead of Édouard Philippe and Raphaël Glucksmann at around 11% each.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: The centre is squeezed out of the run-off in current polls — markets face a populist-vs-populist second round.
insights.locator: Recent polls put Le Pen at around 33%

insights.claim: In a hypothetical French presidential run-off against Jean-Luc Mélenchon, Marine Le Pen polls at around 68%, giving her a commanding second-round lead.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: A Le Pen presidency is the polling base case; price fiscal/EU-policy risk accordingly.
insights.locator: In a hypothetical run-off against Mélenchon

insights.claim: Gavekal frames France's 2027 election under a 'law of surprise', implying that a polling consensus five months out — a Le Pen–Mélenchon run-off — may not be the outcome markets end up facing.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Avoid over-positioning on the current poll consensus; keep optionality on French assets into April 2027.
insights.locator: France’s Election And The Law Of Surprise
